title: Evaluation under input remapping
statement: Let $g$ be a gate, let $\sigma$ map natural-number indices to natural-number indices, and let $v,v'$ be Boolean value lists. If for every input index $a$ of $g$, the value of $v$ at index $\sigma(a)$ (with out-of-range indices treated as false) equals the value of $v'$ at index $a$, then the gate obtained by replacing each input index $a$ with $\sigma(a)$ has the same evaluation on $v$ as $g$ has on $v'$.
hypotheses_covered: A map from natural-number indices to natural-number indices
